messages.subject: Getting value sent from ui.R
parts:
Hi,  I need to get the value of a textbox sent from ui.R in server.R.  Can it be dereferenced only from a reactive function.  When I try the step below, I get the error  "Error in .getReactiveEnvironment()$currentContext() :
  Operation not allowed without an active reactive context. (You tried to do something that can only be done from inside a reactive function.)"



shinyServer(function(input, output) {


    searchstr<-input$searchstring

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Getting value sent from ui.R
parts:
That's right, you must either be in a reactive expression (née reactive function) or observer. It doesn't really make sense to ask for the value of searchstring there; you'll only be taking a snapshot of the value of input$searchstring as the app starts up, and the value in that case will always be NULL.

What is it you're trying to do with the value?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Getting value sent from ui.R
parts:
You would put the pre-processing of your data into a reactive expression (where the result of the expression is the processed value, e.g. subset) and everywhere else in your code would refer to the reactive expression instead of the original data.

I'm not sure what you mean by "send specific values into server.R" though, can you elaborate?

The preprocessing is conditional.  Let me try to explain.  

For example, if I type the expression "school district" then I am not filtering any data, all the code (currently in the global context outside shinyServer) executes.
All the code here is about 8 functions.  The first function gathers all the unique school districts and the subsequent functions are driven by this list.

On the other hand, if I type "school district 460" then the first function should not take all of the school districts but only the one I have typed which is 460 and the rest of the functions use this filtered set.

How do I perform this filtering and run all the functions once so that the data is available for all the reactivePlot functions (there are at least 6 plots I am drawing) in the scope of shinyServer
